title: ledger.changes LEDGER_TRANSFER_POSTED v1 — envelope.data
description: One event per committed business TigerBeetle transfer (codes 1001-1016, 2001-2004, incl. pending creation, void and post of holds). Technical codes 9001-9099 are never published. Envelope: eventId = transferId, aggregateType = LedgerTransfer, aggregateId = debitAccountId (= Kafka key), correlationId = commandId, occurredAt = TB timestamp in ms, producer = ledger-service. Transport: direct (ledger-cdc-bridge role, idempotent Kafka producer), not the outbox.

balanceAfter.description: Cumulative TB counters of the account immediately after this transfer, poisha (declared exception to the Poisha suffix rule). Never null for accounts with the TB history flag (all non-technical accounts); null is tolerated for compatibility only.

transferId.description: Canonical UUID text of the big-endian u128 transfer id; = envelope eventId

commandId.description: TB user_data_128; = envelope correlationId; disbursement: the row commandId

legIndex.description: TB user_data_32; business legs 0..5. Reversal: 0 = hold void, 1..5 = mirror legs

amountPoisha.description: Void legs carry the pending amount

pendingId.description: Set on post/void legs, else null

timestamp.description: TB timestamp, ns since epoch, JSON number; unique and increasing cluster-wide

reasonCode.description: Optional, additive (CCR-GL-03). commandType 10 or 11: the command body's reasonCode read from the committed command journal (null if absent); null for every other command type. May be absent.
